name: petiole-pattern
description: SQLite is the hotpath acceleration layer, not the source of truth. Canonical records live in JSONL/markdown under state/. Rebuild commands restore SQLite from state/ artifacts.

name: one-process-per-model
description: Inference is split into four dedicated workers: fleet-embed (BGE-M3 q8), fleet-rerank (BGE reranker v2 q4), fleet-light (small local model), fleet-heavy (large local model). Each owns one Unix socket. Socket backlog handles queuing.

name: provider-socket-protocol
description: Cloud providers are served through four socket workers: fleet-claude, fleet-gemini, fleet-openai, fleet-openrouter. The harness talks to providers via Unix sockets, not ACP CLI adapters. Each worker manages per-provider rate limits.

name: transport-messaging
description: SQLite-backed agent-mail with burst claim receipts, stale-claim recovery, append-first JSONL under state/mail/, rebuild and verify commands.

name: turn-execution
description: Harness-owned turn loop with strict action envelope (reply, noop, note, sleep_until, queue_task, escalate, scratchpad, spawn_scribe). Split-brain profile selection (light|full|max). Output machete (20k), output budget (8k), section budgets, TDD shorthand.

name: wake-selection
description: Priority-based wake: urgent mail > urgent jobs > private mail > high jobs > public mail > normal > low. Cooldown admits hot wakes only. Rate-limit diagnostics parsed for hibernation windows.

name: job-queue
description: Per-agent agent-jobs with low|normal|high|urgent priority. States: queued, claimed, completed, failed, waiting, blocked, cancelled. Stale-claim recovery. Append-first JSONL under state/jobs/.

name: recovery-system
description: Durable turn journal + checkpoints. Interrupted turns auto-replayed (jobs→reschedule, mail→claim release) unless action phases started (held for manual review). Replay disposition per action type. Deadman timeout kills hung turns.

name: memory-system
description: Tiered memory (working/episodic/archival/digests). Hybrid retrieval: FTS5 + vector + RRF + reranking. HyDE via fleet-heavy, dual keywords via fleet-light. LLM entity extraction at ingest. Typed archival links with validity windows. Timeline, facts, invalidation sections in turn assembly. Ebbinghaus decay.

name: librarian
description: Background importance rebalancing, compaction of episodic/digest into archival lessons with structured fields. Entity extraction maintenance jobs. Maintenance queued via agent-jobs.

name: inference-workers
description: Four workers: fleet-embed (BGE-M3 q8, embed.sock), fleet-rerank (BGE reranker v2 q4, rerank.sock), fleet-light (q4f16, light.sock: summarize, choose_retrieval_mode, choose_turn_profile, decompose_keywords, scribe), fleet-heavy (q4f16, heavy.sock: compact, extract_entities, hyde, scribe).

name: provider-workers
description: Four cloud workers: fleet-claude, fleet-gemini, fleet-openai, fleet-openrouter. Unified socket protocol via fleet-provider/server.ts. Per-provider rate limits, quotas, retry logic.

name: scribe-delegation
description: spawn_scribe action: fire-and-forget to local models. Routing: scribe/milo→fleet-light, homer/roamer/riker→fleet-heavy. Result returns via agent-mail private layer.

name: orchestration
description: Zellij sessions via fleet genesis/terminus/restart. Dynamic KDL layout from config. Governor with per-agent cooldown and rate-limit-aware hibernation. Append-first governor events under state/fleet/.

name: durability
description: Petiole pattern: SQLite hotpath, JSONL canonical under state/. Families: turns, actions, runtime, jobs, mail, governor, reviews, memory, memory-source. Batched action/turn projection. Row-level verify drift.

name: job-dependency-schema
description: fleet_job_dependencies: composite PK (dependent_job_id, blocking_job_id), FK to fleet_internal_jobs, index on blocking_job_id. unblockDependents called on complete+cancel; uses result.changes>0 to filter unblocked list. Cancels also free dependents. Rebuild restores deps from job_dependency JSONL records.

name: job-retry-policy
description: max_retries + retry_count on fleet_internal_jobs. autoRetryOrFail re-queues if retry_count < max_retries (clears claimed fields, records last_error), else marks failed. fail CLI command wires this automatically. queue accepts optional 6th arg for maxRetries.

name: atomic-memory-promotion
description: atomicPromote() in promote.ts: single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction commits tier3_archival + agent_memory_compactions + agent_memory_compaction_items + search index + cross-item links + promoted_compaction_id marking on source artifacts. compact() pattern: all async calls (LLM + embed) complete first, then one atomic DB commit. No partial state possible.
